# sherpa-switch

An immediate binary toggle.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | control |
| Built on | the native `<label>`, which gives click-forwarding |
| Figma | Switch |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-switch/sherpa-switch.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-switch/sherpa-switch.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-switch/sherpa-switch.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-switch/sherpa-switch.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-switch/sherpa-switch.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-switch name="contrast" aria-label="Increase contrast"></sherpa-switch>
<sherpa-switch data-type="simple" name="motion" aria-label="Reduce motion" checked></sherpa-switch>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-description` | text |  | a helper line under the label |
| `data-label` | text |  | its words, beside the track — a click on them toggles it, as on a checkbox |
| `data-type` | `default` `simple` |  | default (rectangular, ON/OFF label, square thumb) \| simple (pill, no label, round thumb) |
| `checked` | boolean, native | `false` | native boolean (current value; drives :checked visuals) |
| `disabled` | boolean, native | `false` | native boolean (reflected onto the inner input) |
| `name` | text, native |  | native string (what a form submits it under) |
| `required` | boolean, native | `false` | native boolean (a form refuses it while off) |
| `value` | text, native | `on` | native string (what it stands for when on; default "on") |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `checked` | `boolean` | read and write | whether the switch is on (delegates to the inner input) |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | read and write | disabled state (reflects host attr + inner input) |
| `value` | `string` | read and write | what it stands for when on (default "on"), as a checkbox's |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions)` | Focus its control: the first focusable part inside. |
| `checkValidity()` | Is it acceptable, as its form sees it? |
| `reportValidity()` | Check, and show the browser's message on the control. |
| `formDisabledCallback()` | Inside a disabled `<fieldset>`, as by its own `disabled`. |
| `formResetCallback()` | A form reset puts back its FIRST `checked`. |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail |
|---|---|
| `change` | `{ checked: boolean; value: string }` |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`description`, `field`, `text`, `title`, `track`
